Model: glob -> commit, FILE granularity (decision 3). Groups are ordered;
first-match-wins, so a path claimed by an earlier group's glob lands in that
commit even if a later group's glob would also match. A file touched by two
logical changes therefore lands in ONE commit - the CHANGELOG carries the
feat/fix nuance, not the commit topology.
Pre-validation (release.py) requires: every changed path is claimed by exactly
one group (no orphans) and every group is non-empty. Put the CHANGELOG riders
